intent: Hand-placed ~/.local/bin scripts are version-controlled in linux_configuration/scripts/ while every existing ~/.local/bin path keeps working through a symlink.
scope: Non-goal: no behaviour change to the moved scripts; callers are not edited
changes: Six scripts copied byte-for-byte (cmp-verified, mode preserved); ~/.local/bin/krita is now named krita-scaled.sh in the repo
unreal-mcp-server is tracked; it reads UNREAL_MCP_PYTHON_DIR (default ~/.local/share/unreal-mcp/unreal-mcp/Python) because a static file cannot bake in --install-dir
install_launcher replaces the heredoc with ln -sfn to the tracked wrapper, chown -h under sudo, and logs a warning to export UNREAL_MCP_PYTHON_DIR when --install-dir is non-default

verification.command: for n in ...; do readlink -f ~/.local/bin/$n; bash -n ~/.local/bin/$n; done
verification.evidence: all seven names resolve into linux_configuration/scripts and parse

verification.command: source lib/unreal_mcp_repo.sh with USER_HOME=<tmpdir>; install_launcher twice over a stale regular file
verification.evidence: regular file replaced by symlink to scripts/unreal-mcp-server; second run idempotent; non-default install dir warning logged

risks: A non-default --install-dir now needs UNREAL_MCP_PYTHON_DIR exported where the MCP client launches the server
Moving or renaming the repo checkout breaks the ~/.local/bin symlinks
rollback: git revert the commit, then cp the scripts from the previous ~/.local/bin state (git show <hash>:linux_configuration/scripts/<file>) over the symlinks
Check systemctl --user status nvidia-pmon.service usage-report-catchup.timer afterwards
